nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) storing token balances of holders.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) storing spending approvals.
Private privileged owner address set to the deployer; gates delegate and batchSend.
Public total token supply assigned in constructor.
Public constant decimals value of 18.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Internal constant router address used for allowance initialization.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; performs allowance and balance updates without SafeMath.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied address.
Owner-only batch transfer that multiplies value by array length and subtracts from owner balance without SafeMath.
Internal pure function computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256 of encoded addresses.
Modifier restricting transfers so that _from or _to is the owner or _from is the computed pair address.
Payable constructor that sets metadata, mints supply to deployer and grants infinite router allowance.
Untrusted caller address used for ownership checks, allowances and balance ownership.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary attacker-influenced address inside delegate().
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length and unchecked balance subtraction in batchSend.
Unchecked subtraction and addition on balanceOf/allowance mappings in transferFrom.
Recipient parameter of transfer().
Amount value parameter used across transfer/transferFrom/approve/batchSend signatures.
Sender parameter of transferFrom().
Array of recipient addresses parameter of batchSend().
Target contract address parameter of delegate().
Calldata bytes parameter passed to delegatecall in delegate().
Spender address parameter of approve().
Local total computed as _value * _tos.length inside batchSend.
Loop index variable inside batchSend.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount into transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared against _from to decide whether to consume allowance.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
ensure compares _from and _to against the owner state variable.
The ensure modifier wraps transferFrom and enforces the transfer restriction.
ensure uses pairFor to derive the UNI pair address used in the require.
The UNI constant router address participates in pair derivation.
delegate requires msg.sender to equal owner before executing.
delegate performs a delegatecall to the caller supplied address a with data b.
batchSend requires msg.sender to equal owner.
batchSend computes total and subtracts balances without SafeMath.
transferFrom mutates balances and allowance using unchecked -= and +=.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
constructor assigns owner.
constructor sets owner to the untrusted deployer msg.sender.
constructor mints the whole supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor sets infinite allowance for the router.
constructor assigns totalSupply.
_to recipient parameter flows into transfer.
_value amount parameter flows into transfer.
_from sender parameter flows into transferFrom.
amount parameter feeds the balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_spender parameter is used as the approval key in approve.
_tos array parameter drives the batchSend loop.
address parameter a is the delegatecall target in delegate.
bytes parameter b is the delegatecall payload in delegate.
local total feeds the unchecked multiplication/balance subtraction.
loop index i controls iteration in batchSend.
local UNI pair address is checked against _from in ensure.
local pair is assigned and returned by pairFor.
constructor grants infinite allowance to the UNI router constant.
delegate reads the owner state variable in its require.
batchSend reads the owner state variable in its require.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only exists to serve transfer's recipient flow and carries no independent security meaning.
The _value amount parameter is consumed by the unchecked balance arithmetic inside transferFrom/transfer.
The _from parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom where it drives allowance and balance updates.
The _tos array parameter is only used by the batchSend loop and total computation.
Parameter a is only the target of the delegatecall inside delegate.
Parameter b is only the calldata payload of the delegatecall inside delegate.
The _spender parameter is only used as the allowance key written by approve.
Local total is the intermediate result that exposes the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Loop index i is a trivial counter scoped to the batchSend loop.
Local UNI is the pair address value computed and checked inside the ensure modifier.
Local pair is the return value of the pure pairFor helper.
